stories.title: #kirkiversary: one year since Charlie Kirk's death
stories.summary: On the first anniversary of Charlie Kirk's death, #kirkiversary trended as X filled with Kirk memes. "It's officially 1 AK (after Kirk)" got 127K likes, a "9/9-9/10-9/11" meme pairing Kirk with Queen Elizabeth II and a plane got 470K, and Netflix UK joined in with "Nearly did himself a neck injury" (150K). Erika Kirk's own post, a wedding photo captioned "...until Heaven.", got 176K.
